body.name: Hfrontier
body.def: \(\mathfrak H_{\mathrm{frontier}}\) denotes the finite-support family \(\mathbf P_\theta\), its observable diagnostics \(\Delta_{N,K}\), \(\operatorname{TV}_{\mathrm{mix}}\), and \(\mathfrak g_{\mathrm{rem}}\), and the alternative jointly normalized \(c_K\)-transform localization.
